title: ID0476978-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/R0300000002002] DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
description:
Reported behavior/issue: DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100 due to Outlet is offline, comm outage: 5001ms
Solution: No longer persisting, this Outlet offline is already being worked by EcoG in SASW-3173, recommendation for now is to check if the switch port or ethernet cable are ok

additional_info.subject: ID0476978-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/R0300000002002] Chargecable Temperature Error CRM:03289000485
additional_info.body:
Hi Laurenz, good morning.
I checked this charger and found where the CableTempSensor error happened:
It seems that between 3rd and 4th january, there was this error where we lost communication to the PLC from the SECC.
Since this last reported issue which was fixed by a reboot, the outlet DC1 has been working and charged 17 times successfully.
From my point of view, there is only a couple of things we can check to fix this:
Change XF1 switch port coming from KF12
Replace Ethernet cable from KF12 to XF1
Worst case scenario, if the problem persists even after performing these 2 tasks above, we might need to replace the EcoG, but in this case I only give the recommendation to replace after you provide feedback that you did the last two.
Let me know what is your opinion, if we should close the ticket since it's no longer persisting or if I send to RC-AT queue for site follow up.
Thank you and have a nice week ahead.
Best regards,
Francisco
